maddeler.e:
نتهافت (form VI)
# نَتَهَافَتُ (natahāfatu) /na.ta.haː.fa.tu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَهَافَتَ (tahāfata)
# نَتَهَافَتَ (natahāfata) /na.ta.haː.fa.ta/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَهَافَتَ (tahāfata)
# نَتَهَافَتْ (natahāfat) /na.ta.haː.fat/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَهَافَتَ (tahāfata)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
